import path from 'path';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

import runtimeErrorOverlay from '@replit/vite-plugin-runtime-error-modal';

const rawPort = process.env.PORT;

if (!rawPort) {
  throw new Error(
    'PORT environment variable is required but was not provided.',
  );
}

const port = Number(rawPort);

if (Number.isNaN(port) || port <= 0) {
  throw new Error(`Invalid PORT value: "${rawPort}"`);
}

const basePath = process.env.BASE_PATH;

if (!basePath) {
  throw new Error(
    'BASE_PATH environment variable is required but was not provided.',
  );
}

export default defineConfig({
  base: basePath,
  plugins: [
    react(),
    tailwindcss({ optimize: false }),
    runtimeErrorOverlay(),
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &&
    process.env.REPL_ID !== undefined
      ? [
          await import('@replit/vite-plugin-cartographer').then((m) =>
            m.cartographer({
              root: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
            }),
          ),
          await import('@replit/vite-plugin-dev-banner').then((m) =>
            m.devBanner(),
          ),
        ]
      : []),
  ],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      '@': path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, 'src'),
      '@assets': path.resolve(
        import.meta.dirname,
        '..',
        '..',
        'attached_assets',
      ),
    },
    dedupe: ['react', 'react-dom'],
  },
  root: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname),
  build: {
    outDir: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, 'dist/public'),
    emptyOutDir: true,
  },
  server: {
    port,
    strictPort: true,
    host: '0.0.0.0',
    allowedHosts: true,
    fs: {
      strict: true,
    },
  },
  preview: {
    port,
    host: '0.0.0.0',
    allowedHosts: true,
  },
});

  <Route path="/profile">{()=><Protected><ProfilePage/></Protected>}</Route>
  <Route>{()=><Protected><NotFound/></Protected>}</Route>
 </Switch></RoutedErrorBoundary>;
}
function ClerkProviderWithRoutes(){
 const [,setLocation]=useLocation();
 return <ClerkProvider publishableKey={clerkPubKey} proxyUrl={clerkProxyUrl} appearance={clerkAppearance} signInUrl={`${basePath}/sign-in`} signUpUrl={`${basePath}/sign-up`} localization={{signIn:{start:{title:'Welcome back',subtitle:'Sign in to see what is moving.'}},signUp:{start:{title:'Start with a clear picture',subtitle:'Create your StockSense account.'}}}} routerPush={to=>setLocation(stripBase(to))} routerReplace={to=>setLocation(stripBase(to),{replace:true})}>
   <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}><ClerkQueryClientCacheInvalidator/><TooltipProvider><Routes/><Toaster/></TooltipProvider></QueryClientProvider>
 </ClerkProvider>;
}
function App(){return <WouterRouter base={basePath}><NavigationMotionProvider><ClerkProviderWithRoutes/></NavigationMotionProvider></WouterRouter>}
export default App;

  },
}).render(
  <ErrorBoundary>
    <App />
  </ErrorBoundary>,
);

import { type ReactNode, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation } from 'wouter';
import { useUser } from '@clerk/react';
import { Package, Menu, X, ChevronRight, Plus, AlertCircle, Search, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { navigationLinks, useNavigationMotion } from './navigation-motion';

export function Brand({ light = false }: { light?: boolean }) {
  return <Link href="/" className={`brand ${light ? 'brand-light' : ''}`} data-testid="link-brand"><span className="brand-mark"><Package size={20} strokeWidth={2.5}/></span><span className={`brand-name ${light ? 'brand-name-light' : ''}`}>StockSense<span className="brand-dot">.</span></span></Link>;
}
export function Shell({ children, title }: { children:ReactNode; title:string }) {
  const [path] = useLocation(); const [open,setOpen] = useState(false); const {user} = useUser();
  const { target, sequence, trigger } = useNavigationMotion();
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (target !== path || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/delivery-progress.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getGetDashboardQueryKey,
  getGetOperationQueryKey,
  getListOperationsQueryKey,
  useAssignDeliveryCourier,
  type Operation,
} from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import './delivery-progress.css';

function timestamp(value: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }).format(new Date(value));
}

export function DeliveryProgress({ operation }: { operation: Operation }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const assign = useAssignDeliveryCourier();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  if (operation.type !== 'delivery') return null;

  const started = operation.deliveryStartedAt !== null;
  const finished = operation.deliveryCompletedAt !== null;
  const refresh = () => {
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetOperationQueryKey(operation.id) });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListOperationsQueryKey() });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetDashboardQueryKey() });
    setError('');
  };
  const onError = (reason: unknown) => setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : 'Could not update this delivery. Please try again.');

  return (
    <section className="delivery-progress" aria-label="Delivery tracking" data-testid="delivery-progress">
      <div className="delivery-progress-heading">
        <span className="delivery-progress-icon"><Truck size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">DELIVERY TRACKING</div>
          <h3>{finished ? 'Delivery done' : started ? 'Delivery in progress' : 'Ready for the delivery person'}</h3>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="delivery-progress-dates">
        <div>
          <span>Delivery started</span>
          <strong data-testid="delivery-started-date">{operation.deliveryStartedAt ? timestamp(operation.deliveryStartedAt) : 'Not started yet'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Delivery done</span>
          <strong data-testid="delivery-completed-date">{operation.deliveryCompletedAt ? timestamp(operation.deliveryCompletedAt) : 'Not completed yet'}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="delivery-progress-note">Assigned courier: <strong>{operation.courierEmail || 'Not assigned'}</strong></p>
      {!started && !finished && (
        <form onSubmit={event => {
          event.preventDefault();
          assign.mutate({ id: operation.id, data: { email: email.trim() || null } }, {
            onSuccess: () => { refresh(); setEmail(''); },
            onError,
          });
        }}>
          <label className="field-group">
            <span className="label">Courier account email</span>
            <input className="field" type="email" value={email} onChange={event => setEmail(event.target.value)} placeholder="courier@example.com" data-testid="input-courier-email" />
          </label>
          <button className="btn btn-primary delivery-progress-action" type="submit" disabled={assign.isPending}>
            {assign.isPending ? 'Saving…' : email.trim() ? 'Assign courier' : 'Remove assignment'}
          </button>
          <p className="delivery-progress-note">The courier must first sign up and verify this email. Only their account can start and finish the delivery.</p>
        </form>
      )}
      {operation.status !== 'done' && operation.status !== 'canceled' && (
        <p className="delivery-progress-note">Validate the outgoing stock movement before the delivery person starts.</p>
      )}
      {operation.status === 'canceled' && <p className="delivery-progress-note">This delivery was canceled.</p>}
      {finished && <p className="delivery-progress-note" role="status">Recorded as delivered on {timestamp(operation.deliveryCompletedAt!)}.</p>}
      {error && <p className="delivery-progress-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/error-boundary.tsx

import {
  Component,
  type ComponentType,
  type ErrorInfo,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

export interface ErrorFallbackProps {
  error: Error;
  resetError: () => void;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  FallbackComponent?: ComponentType<ErrorFallbackProps>;
  /** Changing this clears a caught error. Pass the route to recover on navigation. */
  resetKey?: unknown;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  error: Error | null;
}

function toError(value: unknown): Error {
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return new Error(value);
  }
  try {
    return new Error(JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    return new Error(String(value));
  }
}

function DefaultFallback({ error, resetError }: ErrorFallbackProps) {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-lg w-full text-center">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">
          Something went wrong
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
          This part of the app hit an error. The rest of the app is still
          running.
        </p>
        {/* Dev only: messages can carry API responses and other internals. */}
        {import.meta.env.DEV ? (
          <pre className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded bg-gray-100 p-3 text-left text-xs text-gray-800">
            {error.message || String(error)}
          </pre>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={resetError}
          className="mt-4 rounded bg-gray-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white hover:bg-gray-700"
        >
          Try again
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<
  ErrorBoundaryProps,
  ErrorBoundaryState
> {
  state: ErrorBoundaryState = { error: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: unknown): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { error: toError(error) };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: unknown, info: ErrorInfo): void {
    console.error(
      'ErrorBoundary caught an error:',
      toError(error),
      info.componentStack,
    );
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps): void {
    if (
      this.state.error !== null &&
      prevProps.resetKey !== this.props.resetKey
    ) {
      this.resetError();
    }
  }

  resetError = (): void => {
    this.setState({ error: null });
  };

  render(): ReactNode {
    const { error } = this.state;
    if (error === null) {
      return this.props.children;
    }
    const Fallback = this.props.FallbackComponent ?? DefaultFallback;
    return <Fallback error={error} resetError={this.resetError} />;
  }
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { getListGooglePlaceSuggestionsQueryKey, useGetGooglePlacesConfig, useListGooglePlaceSuggestions, useResolveGooglePlace, type GooglePlaceResult } from '@workspace/api-client-react';

type Pin = { latitude: number; longitude: number };
type MapApi = {
  Map: new (element: HTMLElement, options: object) => {
    panTo: (pin: { lat: number; lng: number }) => void;
    setZoom: (zoom: number) => void;
    addListener: (event: string, callback: (event: { latLng?: { lat: () => number; lng: () => number } }) => void) => void;
  };
  Marker: new (options: object) => { setPosition: (pin: { lat: number; lng: number }) => void; setMap: (map: object | null) => void };
};
declare global { interface Window { google?: { maps: MapApi }; gm_authFailure?: () => void } }

let mapsScript: Promise<MapApi> | null = null;
function loadGoogleMap(key: string): Promise<MapApi> {
  if (window.google?.maps) return Promise.resolve(window.google.maps);
  if (!mapsScript) mapsScript = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}&v=weekly`;
    script.async = true;
    script.onerror = () => { mapsScript = null; reject(new Error('Google map failed to load. Check the browser key and allowed website domains.')); };
    window.gm_authFailure = () => { mapsScript = null; reject(new Error('Google Maps authorization failed. Check the browser key, Maps JavaScript API, billing, and website restrictions.')); };
    script.onload = () => window.google?.maps ? resolve(window.google.maps) : reject(new Error('Google Maps is unavailable.'));
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
  return mapsScript;
}

export type ConfirmedGoogleSelection = { result: GooglePlaceResult; source: { placeId: string } | { pin: Pin } };

export function GooglePlacePicker({ onConfirm, onEdit }: { onConfirm: (selection: ConfirmedGoogleSelection) => void; onEdit: () => void }) {
  const config = useGetGooglePlacesConfig();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState('');
  const [candidate, setCandidate] = useState<{ placeId: string } | { pin: Pin } | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<GooglePlaceResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [mapError, setMapError] = useState('');
  const mapElement = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const map = useRef<InstanceType<MapApi['Map']> | null>(null);
  const marker = useRef<InstanceType<MapApi['Marker']> | null>(null);
  const requestId = useRef(0);
  const resolve = useResolveGooglePlace();
  const suggestions = useListGooglePlaceSuggestions({ query: debounced }, { query: { queryKey: getListGooglePlaceSuggestionsQueryKey({ query: debounced }), enabled: config.data?.enabled === true && debounced.length >= 3, retry: false, staleTime: 60_000 } });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setDebounced(search.trim()), 400);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!config.data?.enabled || !config.data.browserKey || !mapElement.current) return;
    let active = true;
    loadGoogleMap(config.data.browserKey).then(api => {
      if (!active || !mapElement.current || map.current) return;
      const instance = new api.Map(mapElement.current, { center: { lat: 39.5, lng: -98.35 }, zoom: 4, mapTypeControl: false, streetViewControl: false });
      const pin = new api.Marker({ map: instance });
      map.current = instance;
      marker.current = pin;
      instance.addListener('click', event => {
        if (!event.latLng) return;
        const selected = { latitude: event.latLng.lat(), longitude: event.latLng.lng() };
        pin.setPosition({ lat: selected.latitude, lng: selected.longitude });
        requestId.current++;
        setCandidate({ pin: selected });
        setPreview(null);
        onEdit();
        setError('');
      });
    }).catch(reason => { if (active) setMapError(String(reason)); });
    return () => { active = false; marker.current?.setMap(null); marker.current = null; map.current = null; };
  }, [config.data?.enabled, config.data?.browserKey, onEdit]);

  const choosePlace = (placeId: string) => {
    const id = ++requestId.current;
    setCandidate({ placeId });
    setPreview(null);
    onEdit();
    setError('');
    resolve.mutate({ data: { placeId } }, {
      onSuccess: result => {
        if (id !== requestId.current) return;
        setPreview(result);
        const pin = { lat: result.latitude, lng: result.longitude };
        map.current?.panTo(pin);
        map.current?.setZoom(16);
        marker.current?.setPosition(pin);
      },
      onError: reason => { if (id === requestId.current) setError(String(reason)); },
    });
  };
  const previewPin = () => {
    if (!candidate || !('pin' in candidate)) return;
    const id = ++requestId.current;
    resolve.mutate({ data: candidate }, {
      onSuccess: result => { if (id === requestId.current) setPreview(result); },
      onError: reason => { if (id === requestId.current) setError(String(reason)); },
    });
  };

  if (config.isLoading) return <p className="location-note" role="status">Checking Google Maps availability…</p>;
  if (config.isError) return <p className="location-error" role="alert">Google Maps availability could not be checked. Manual address entry still works. <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => config.refetch()}>Retry</button></p>;
  if (!config.data?.enabled) return <p className="location-note">Google place suggestions and pin selection are unavailable until the Maps browser and server keys are configured. You can still save a typed address or device coordinates.</p>;

  return <div className="google-place-picker">
    <h5>Choose a Google place or map pin</h5>
    <p className="location-note">Search after 3 characters (maximum 120). Up to 30 Google lookups per minute per account; Google Maps may also apply your project's billing quotas. Nothing is saved until you confirm below and save the location.</p>
    <input className="field" value={search} maxLength={120} onChange={event => { requestId.current++; setSearch(event.target.value); setCandidate(null); setPreview(null); onEdit(); }} placeholder="Search places on Google Maps" aria-label="Search Google places" />
    {suggestions.isFetching && <p className="location-note" role="status">Searching Google Places…</p>}
    {suggestions.isError && <p className="location-error" role="alert">{String(suggestions.error)}</p>}
    {debounced.length >= 3 && !suggestions.isFetching && !suggestions.isError && <div className="google-suggestions" role="listbox" aria-label="Google place suggestions">
      {suggestions.data?.length ? suggestions.data.map(item => <button role="option" aria-selected={candidate !== null && 'placeId' in candidate && candidate.placeId === item.placeId} type="button" key={item.placeId} onClick={() => choosePlace(item.placeId)}>{item.text}</button>) : <p className="location-note">No Google places found. You can still type an address manually.</p>}
    </div>}
    <div className="location-map"><div ref={mapElement} className="google-map-canvas" aria-label="Google map; click to choose a pin" /><div className="location-map-caption">Click the map to place an exact pin. Google finds a nearby address for that pin; check it before confirming.</div></div>
    {mapError && <p className="location-error" role="alert">{mapError}</p>}
    {'pin' in (candidate ?? {}) && !preview && <button type="button" className="btn btn-soft" disabled={resolve.isPending} onClick={previewPin}>Find address at pin</button>}
    {resolve.isPending && <p className="location-note" role="status">Checking with Google…</p>}
    {error && <p className="location-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {preview && candidate && <div className="google-place-confirm"><p><strong>Google result:</strong> {preview.address}<br />Pin: {preview.latitude.toFixed(5)}, {preview.longitude.toFixed(5)}</p><button type="button" className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => { onConfirm({ result: preview, source: candidate }); setError(''); }}>Confirm this place & pin</button></div>}
    <p className="location-note">Place information and maps © Google. A manually typed address is not verified by Google.</p>
  </div>;
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/navigation-motion.tsx

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Activity, Package, ArrowLeftRight, History, Settings2 } from 'lucide-react';

export const navigationLinks = [
  { href: '/dashboard', label: 'Overview', icon: Activity },
  { href: '/products', label: 'Products', icon: Package },
  { href: '/operations', label: 'Operations', icon: ArrowLeftRight },
  { href: '/moves', label: 'Stock ledger', icon: History },
  { href: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings2 },
] as const;

type NavigationMotion = {
  target: string | null;
  sequence: number;
  trigger: (href: string) => void;
};

const NavigationMotionContext = createContext<NavigationMotion | null>(null);

export function NavigationMotionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState({ target: null as string | null, sequence: 0 });
  const clearTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const activeItem = navigationLinks.find(({ href }) => href === motion.target);
  const Icon = activeItem?.icon;

  const trigger = useCallback((href: string) => {
    if (clearTimer.current) clearTimeout(clearTimer.current);
    setMotion((current) => ({ target: href, sequence: current.sequence + 1 }));
    clearTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setMotion((current) => ({ ...current, target: null }));
      clearTimer.current = null;
    }, 1150);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (clearTimer.current) clearTimeout(clearTimer.current);
  }, []);

  return (
    <NavigationMotionContext.Provider value={{ ...motion, trigger }}>
      {children}
      {activeItem && Icon && createPortal(
        <div key={motion.sequence} className="nav-splash" aria-hidden="true" data-testid={`animation-${activeItem.label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`}>
          <div className="nav-splash-content">
            <span className="nav-splash-icon"><Icon size={78} strokeWidth={1.8}/></span>
            <span className="nav-splash-label">{activeItem.label}</span>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </NavigationMotionContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useNavigationMotion() {
  const motion = useContext(NavigationMotionContext);
  if (!motion) throw new Error('Navigation motion must be used inside its provider.');
  return motion;
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/operation-form.tsx

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import {
  useListProducts,
  useListLocations,
  type Operation,
  type OperationType,
  type OperationInput,
  type OperationUpdate,
} from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Field, Modal } from './common';

type Row = { productId: string; quantity: string };

function localDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  return new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

export function OperationForm({
  operation, onClose, onSave, busy, error,
}: {
  operation?: Operation;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (data: OperationInput | OperationUpdate) => void;
  busy: boolean;
  error?: string;
}) {
  const products = useListProducts();
  const locations = useListLocations();
  const [type, setType] = useState<OperationType>(operation?.type || 'receipt');
  const [contact, setContact] = useState(operation?.contact || '');
  const [source, setSource] = useState(operation?.sourceLocationId?.toString() || '');
  const [destination, setDestination] = useState(operation?.destinationLocationId?.toString() || '');
  const [scheduled, setScheduled] = useState(operation?.scheduledAt ? localDateTime(operation.scheduledAt) : '');
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<Row[]>(
    operation?.lines.map(line => ({
      productId: String(line.productId),
      quantity: String(operation.type === 'adjustment' ? line.countedQuantity ?? 0 : line.quantity),
    })) || [{ productId: '', quantity: '' }],
  );
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState('');
  const changingType = !!operation && type !== operation.type;

  const updateLine = (index: number, key: keyof Row, value: string) => {
    setLines(previous => previous.map((row, i) => i === index ? { ...row, [key]: value } : row));
    setLocalError('');
  };

  const changeType = (nextType: OperationType) => {
    if (nextType === type) return;
    if ((type === 'adjustment') !== (nextType === 'adjustment')) {
      // A stock count is an absolute value; other quantities are amounts moved.
      setLines(previous => previous.map(row => ({ ...row, quantity: '' })));
    }
    if (nextType === 'receipt') setSource('');
    if (nextType === 'delivery' || nextType === 'adjustment') setDestination('');
    setType(nextType);
    setLocalError('');
  };

  const submit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (type === 'receipt' && !destination) {
      setLocalError('Choose a destination for incoming stock.');
      return;
    }
    if (['delivery', 'transfer', 'adjustment'].includes(type) && !source) {
      setLocalError('Choose a source location.');
      return;
    }
    if (type === 'transfer' && (!destination || source === destination)) {
      setLocalError('Choose a different destination for the transfer.');
      return;
    }
    const productIds = lines.map(line => line.productId);
    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      setLocalError('Add each product only once per operation.');
      return;
    }
    if (lines.some(line => !line.productId || line.quantity.trim() === '' ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(line.quantity)) ||
      (type === 'adjustment' ? Number(line.quantity) < 0 : Number(line.quantity) <= 0))) {
      setLocalError(type === 'adjustment'
        ? 'Choose a product and enter a counted quantity of zero or more for every line.'
        : 'Choose a product and enter a quantity greater than zero for every line.');
      return;
    }
    setLocalError('');
    const base = {
      contact: contact.trim() || null,
      sourceLocationId: type === 'receipt' ? null : source ? Number(source) : null,
      destinationLocationId: type === 'receipt' || type === 'transfer' ? Number(destination) : null,
      scheduledAt: scheduled ? new Date(scheduled).toISOString() : null,
      lines: lines.map(line => ({
        productId: Number(line.productId),
        ...(type === 'adjustment'
          ? { countedQuantity: Number(line.quantity) }
          : { quantity: Number(line.quantity) }),
      })),
    };
    onSave(operation ? { ...base, ...(changingType ? { type } : {}) } : { ...base, type });
  };

  return <Modal title={operation ? 'Edit operation' : 'New operation'} onClose={onClose}>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <div className="grid-fields">
        <Field label="Operation type *">
          <select className="field" value={type} onChange={event => changeType(event.target.value as OperationType)} data-testid="select-operation-type">
            <option value="receipt">Receipt — stock coming in</option>
            <option value="delivery">Delivery — stock going out</option>
            <option value="transfer">Transfer — move between locations</option>
            <option value="adjustment">Adjustment — correct a count</option>
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Contact / reference party">
          <input className="field" value={contact} onChange={event => setContact(event.target.value)} placeholder="Supplier or recipient" data-testid="input-operation-contact" />
        </Field>
        <Field label={`Source location ${type === 'delivery' || type === 'transfer' || type === 'adjustment' ? '*' : ''}`}>
          <select className="field" required={type !== 'receipt'} value={source} onChange={event => setSource(event.target.value)} data-testid="select-source-location">
            <option value="">Select source</option>
            {locations.data?.map(location => <option key={location.id} value={location.id}>{location.warehouseName} / {location.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label={`Destination location ${type === 'receipt' || type === 'transfer' ? '*' : ''}`}>
          <select className="field" required={type === 'receipt' || type === 'transfer'} value={destination} onChange={event => setDestination(event.target.value)} data-testid="select-destination-location">
            <option value="">Select destination</option>
            {locations.data?.map(location => <option key={location.id} value={location.id}>{location.warehouseName} / {location.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Scheduled for">
          <input type="datetime-local" className="field" value={scheduled} onChange={event => setScheduled(event.target.value)} data-testid="input-scheduled-at" />
        </Field>
      </div>
      {changingType && <p role="status" style={{ margin: '14px 0 0', fontSize: 12, color: '#875720' }}>
        Changing type returns this operation to Draft and updates its reference.
        {operation?.courierEmail && ' Its courier assignment will be removed.'}
        {(type === 'adjustment') !== (operation?.type === 'adjustment') && ' Enter a new quantity: counted stock and stock moved mean different things.'}
      </p>}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', margin: '27px 0 13px' }}>
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">LINE ITEMS</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#728b80', marginTop: 5 }}>
            {type === 'adjustment' ? 'Enter the actual counted quantity.' : 'Enter the quantity to move.'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button className="btn btn-soft" type="button" onClick={() => setLines(previous => [...previous, { productId: '', quantity: '' }])} data-testid="button-add-line"><Plus size={14} /> Add line</button>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 10 }}>
        {lines.map((row, index) => <div key={index} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 110px 34px', gap: 8 }}>
          <select className="field" required value={row.productId} onChange={event => updateLine(index, 'productId', event.target.value)} data-testid={`select-line-product-${index}`}>
            <option value="">Select product</option>
            {products.data?.map(product => <option value={product.id} key={product.id}>{product.name} · {product.sku}</option>)}
          </select>
          <input className="field" type="number" min="0" step="any" required placeholder={type === 'adjustment' ? 'Count' : 'Qty'} value={row.quantity} onChange={event => updateLine(index, 'quantity', event.target.value)} data-testid={`input-line-quantity-${index}`} />
          <button className="btn btn-outline icon-btn" type="button" disabled={lines.length === 1} onClick={() => setLines(previous => previous.filter((_, i) => i !== index))} aria-label="Remove line" data-testid={`button-remove-line-${index}`}><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
        </div>)}
      </div>
      {(localError || error) && <p style={{ color: '#a34432', fontSize: 12 }} role="alert" data-testid="status-operation-form-error">{localError || error}</p>}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 9, marginTop: 28 }}>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
        <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy} data-testid="button-save-operation">{busy ? 'Saving…' : operation ? 'Save changes' : 'Create draft'}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </Modal>;
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/overview-selection-panel.tsx
==========================================================================================
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'wouter';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getGetDashboardQueryKey,
  getGetOperationQueryKey,
  getListMovesQueryKey,
  getListOperationsQueryKey,
  getListProductsQueryKey,
  useCancelOperation,
  useUpdateOperation,
  useValidateOperation,
  type Operation,
  type OperationStatus,
  type Product,
} from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import {
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Ban,
  CalendarClock,
  Check,
  Clock3,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Truck,
  Warehouse,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Confirm, dateText, numberText, Status } from './common';
import { DeliveryProgress } from './delivery-progress';
import { unitLooksLikeQuantity } from './product-display';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from './ui/sheet';

export type OverviewSelection =
  | { kind: 'operation'; id: number }
  | { kind: 'product'; id: number };

type OverviewSelectionPanelProps = {
  selection: OverviewSelection | null;
  operation?: Operation;
  product?: Product;
  operationsLoading: boolean;
  operationsError: boolean;
  productsLoading: boolean;
  productsError: boolean;
  retryOperations: () => void;
  retryProducts: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

const workflowSteps: OperationStatus[] = ['draft', 'waiting', 'ready', 'done'];

function operationStatusText(operation: Operation) {
  if (operation.type === 'delivery' && operation.deliveryCompletedAt) return 'Delivery done';
  if (operation.type === 'delivery' && operation.deliveryStartedAt) return 'In transit';
  if (operation.type === 'delivery' && operation.status === 'waiting') return 'Picked';
  if (operation.type === 'delivery' && operation.status === 'ready') return 'Packed';
  return operation.status;
}

function operationTypeIcon(operation: Operation) {
  if (operation.type === 'delivery') return Truck;
  if (operation.type === 'transfer') return ArrowLeftRight;
  if (operation.type === 'adjustment') return SlidersHorizontal;
  if (operation.type === 'receipt') return ArrowDownLeft;
  return Package;
}

function scheduledText(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return 'Not scheduled';
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (!value.includes('T') || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateText(value);
  return `${dateText(value)} · ${new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
  }).format(date)}`;
}

function PanelLoading() {
  return (
    <div className="overview-drawer-state" role="status">
      <span className="overview-drawer-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
      Loading live details…
    </div>
  );
}

function PanelUnavailable({ onRetry }: { onRetry: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="overview-drawer-state overview-drawer-unavailable" role="alert">
      <p>These details couldn’t be loaded.</p>
      <button className="btn btn-outline" type="button" onClick={onRetry} data-testid="button-retry-overview-details">
        Retry
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function OverviewSelectionPanel({
  selection,
  operation,
  product,
  operationsLoading,
  operationsError,
  productsLoading,
  productsError,
  retryOperations,
  retryProducts,
  onClose,
}: OverviewSelectionPanelProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const update = useUpdateOperation();
  const validate = useValidateOperation();
  const cancel = useCancelOperation();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [confirmCancel, setConfirmCancel] = useState(false);
  const busy = update.isPending || validate.isPending || cancel.isPending;

  const refreshOperationData = (id: number) => {
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetOperationQueryKey(id) });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListOperationsQueryKey() });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetDashboardQueryKey() });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListProductsQueryKey() });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListMovesQueryKey() });
  };

  const setStatus = (id: number, status: OperationStatus) => {
    setError('');
    update.mutate(
      { id, data: { status } },
      {
        onSuccess: () => refreshOperationData(id),
        onError: mutationError => setError(String(mutationError)),
      },
    );
  };

  const validateOperation = (id: number) => {
    setError('');
    validate.mutate(
      { id },
      {
        onSuccess: () => refreshOperationData(id),
        onError: mutationError => setError(String(mutationError)),
      },
    );
  };

  const cancelOperation = (id: number) => {
    setError('');
    cancel.mutate(
      { id },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refreshOperationData(id);
          setConfirmCancel(false);
        },
        onError: mutationError => {
          setConfirmCancel(false);
          setError(String(mutationError));
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const editable = operation
    ? ['draft', 'waiting', 'ready'].includes(operation.status)
    : false;
  const statusIndex = operation && operation.status !== 'canceled'
    ? workflowSteps.indexOf(operation.status)
    : -1;
  const operationUnits = operation?.lines.reduce(
    (sum, line) => sum + (operation.type === 'adjustment' ? line.countedQuantity ?? 0 : line.quantity),
    0,
  ) ?? 0;
  const Icon = operation ? operationTypeIcon(operation) : Package;

  return (
    <Sheet
      open={selection !== null}
      onOpenChange={open => {
        if (!open) {
          setError('');
          setConfirmCancel(false);
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <SheetContent
        className="overview-drawer"
      >
        <SheetTitle className="sr-only">
          {selection?.kind === 'product'
            ? product?.name || 'Product details'
            : operation?.reference || 'Movement details'}
        </SheetTitle>
        {selection?.kind === 'operation' && (
          operationsLoading ? <PanelLoading />
            : operationsError ? <PanelUnavailable onRetry={retryOperations} />
              : !operation ? (
                <div className="overview-drawer-state">
                  <p>This operation is no longer available in the current queue.</p>
                  <Link href="/operations" className="btn btn-outline" data-testid="link-overview-open-operations">Open operations</Link>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <SheetHeader className="overview-drawer-header">
                    <div className="overview-drawer-heading-row">
                      <span className="overview-drawer-icon"><Icon size={20} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
                      <div className="overview-drawer-heading-copy">
                        <div className="eyebrow">MOVEMENT DOSSIER / {operation.type.toUpperCase()}</div>
                        <h2 className="overview-drawer-title">{operation.reference}</h2>
                      </div>
                      <Status value={operation.status} label={operationStatusText(operation)} />
                    </div>
                    <SheetDescription>
                      Review the route, items, and next workflow step for this movement.
                    </SheetDescription>
                  </SheetHeader>

                  <div className="overview-drawer-scroll">
                    <section className="overview-dossier-section" aria-label="Movement route">
                      <div className="overview-dossier-label">{operation.type === 'adjustment' ? 'STOCK COUNT LOCATION' : 'MOVEMENT ROUTE'}</div>
                      <div className="overview-route">
                        {operation.type === 'adjustment' ? (
                          <div>
                            <span>Counted at</span>
                            <strong>{operation.sourceLocationName || operation.destinationLocationName || 'Unknown location'}</strong>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                        <div>
                          <span>From</span>
                          <strong>{operation.sourceLocationName || (operation.type === 'receipt' ? operation.contact : null) || 'External'}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <ArrowRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                        <div>
                          <span>To</span>
                          <strong>{operation.destinationLocationName || (operation.type === 'delivery' ? operation.contact : null) || 'External'}</strong>
                        </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="overview-dossier-meta">
                        <div>
                          <CalendarClock size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                          <span>Scheduled</span>
                          <strong>{scheduledText(operation.scheduledAt)}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Warehouse size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                          <span>Contact</span>
                          <strong>{operation.contact || '—'}</strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </section>

                    <section className="overview-dossier-section" aria-label="Operation items">
                      <div className="overview-dossier-section-heading">
                        <div>
                          <div className="overview-dossier-label">ITEMS IN THIS MOVEMENT</div>
                          <h3>{operation.lines.length} {operation.lines.length === 1 ? 'product' : 'products'}</h3>
                        </div>
                        <span className="overview-line-count">
                          {numberText(operationUnits)} units
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {operation.lines.length ? (
                        <div className="overview-line-list">
                          {operation.lines.map(line => (
                            <div className="overview-line-item" key={line.id} data-testid={`overview-operation-line-${line.id}`}>
                              <span className="overview-line-icon"><Package size={15} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
                              <span className="overview-line-copy">
                                <strong>{line.productName}</strong>
                                <small>{line.sku}</small>
                              </span>
                              <span className="overview-line-quantity">
                                {operation.type === 'adjustment' && line.countedQuantity !== null
                                  ? numberText(line.countedQuantity)
                                  : numberText(line.quantity)}
                                <small style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 3, color: '#70838e', fontWeight: 400 }}>Unit: {line.unit}</small>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="overview-drawer-muted">No product lines have been added yet.</p>
                      )}
                    </section>

                    <section className="overview-dossier-section" aria-label="Workflow checkpoint">
                      <div className="overview-dossier-label">WORKFLOW CHECKPOINT</div>
                      <div className={`overview-workflow ${operation.status === 'canceled' ? 'is-canceled' : ''}`}>
                        {workflowSteps.map((step, index) => (
                          <div className={`overview-workflow-step ${index <= statusIndex ? 'is-complete' : ''} ${index === statusIndex ? 'is-current' : ''}`} key={step}>
                            <span>{index < statusIndex ? <Check size={13} /> : index + 1}</span>
                            <small>{operation.type === 'delivery' && step === 'waiting' ? 'Picked' : operation.type === 'delivery' && step === 'ready' ? 'Packed' : step}</small>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="overview-next-action">
                        {operation.status === 'ready'
                          ? 'Validate this movement to update stock and the ledger.'
                          : operation.status === 'waiting'
                            ? 'Check the route and item quantities before confirming it as ready.'
                            : operation.status === 'draft'
                              ? 'Review the operation details before moving it into the workflow.'
                              : operation.status === 'canceled'
                                ? 'This movement was canceled and cannot be validated.'
                                : 'This movement is complete. Its stock changes are in the ledger.'}
                      </div>
                    </section>
                    <DeliveryProgress operation={operation} />

                    {error && <div className="overview-drawer-error" role="alert" data-testid="status-overview-operation-error">{error}</div>}
                  </div>

                  <div className="overview-drawer-footer">
                    <div className="overview-drawer-actions">
                      {editable && operation.status === 'draft' && (
                        <button className="btn btn-outline" type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setStatus(operation.id, 'waiting')} data-testid="button-drawer-mark-waiting">
                          {operation.type === 'delivery' ? 'Mark as picked' : 'Mark as waiting'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {editable && (operation.status === 'draft' || operation.status === 'waiting') && (
                        <button className="btn btn-primary" type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setStatus(operation.id, 'ready')} data-testid="button-drawer-mark-ready">
                          <Check size={15} />{operation.type === 'delivery' ? 'Mark as packed' : 'Confirm as ready'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {editable && (
                        <button className="btn btn-primary" type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => validateOperation(operation.id)} data-testid="button-drawer-validate-operation">
                          <Check size={15} />{validate.isPending ? 'Validating…' : 'Validate movement'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {editable && (
                        <button className="btn btn-danger overview-drawer-cancel" type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirmCancel(true)} data-testid="button-drawer-cancel-operation">
                          <Ban size={14} />Cancel
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {update.isPending && <span className="overview-drawer-saving" role="status"><Clock3 size={13} />Saving workflow step…</span>}
                    <Link href={`/operations/${operation.id}`} className="overview-drawer-full-link" data-testid="link-drawer-full-operation">
                      Open full operation <ArrowUpRight size={14} />
                    </Link>
                  </div>

                  {confirmCancel && (
                    <Confirm
                      title="Cancel operation?"
                      description="This operation will be canceled and can no longer be validated."
                      onClose={() => setConfirmCancel(false)}
                      onConfirm={() => cancelOperation(operation.id)}
                      busy={cancel.isPending}
                    />
                  )}
                </>
              )
        )}

        {selection?.kind === 'product' && (
          productsLoading ? <PanelLoading />
            : productsError ? <PanelUnavailable onRetry={retryProducts} />
              : !product ? (
                <div className="overview-drawer-state">
                  <p>This product is no longer in the active catalog.</p>
                  <Link href="/products" className="btn btn-outline" data-testid="link-overview-open-products">Open products</Link>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <SheetHeader className="overview-drawer-header">
                    <div className="overview-drawer-heading-row">
                      <span className="overview-drawer-icon"><Package size={20} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
                      <div className="overview-drawer-heading-copy">
                        <div className="eyebrow">PRODUCT DOSSIER / <span className="mono">{product.sku}</span></div>
                        <h2 className="overview-drawer-title">{product.name}</h2>
                      </div>
                      <Status value={product.stockStatus} />
                    </div>
                    <SheetDescription>
                      Stock position and storage locations from the live product catalog.
                    </SheetDescription>
                  </SheetHeader>

                  <div className="overview-drawer-scroll">
                    <section className="overview-product-metrics" aria-label="Product stock summary">
                      <div>
                        <span>ON HAND</span>
                        <strong>{numberText(product.totalStock)}</strong>
                        <small>{unitLooksLikeQuantity(product.unit) ? 'Unit needs correction' : product.unit}</small>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span>REORDER POINT</span>
                        <strong>{numberText(product.reorderPoint)}</strong>
                        <small>{unitLooksLikeQuantity(product.unit) ? 'Unit needs correction' : product.unit}</small>
                      </div>
                    </section>

                    <section className="overview-dossier-section" aria-label="Product information">
                      <div className="overview-dossier-label">PRODUCT DETAILS</div>
                      <div className="overview-product-facts">
                        <div><span>Category</span><strong>{product.categoryName || 'Uncategorized'}</strong></div>
                        <div><span>Created</span><strong>{dateText(product.createdAt)}</strong></div>
                        <div><span>Storage default</span><strong>{product.defaultLocationName ? `${product.defaultWarehouseName} / ${product.defaultLocationName}` : 'Not set'}</strong></div>
                      </div>
                    </section>

                    <section className="overview-dossier-section" aria-label="Stock by location">
                      <div className="overview-dossier-section-heading">
                        <div>
                          <div className="overview-dossier-label">STOCK BY LOCATION</div>
                          <h3>{product.locationStocks.length} {product.locationStocks.length === 1 ? 'location' : 'locations'}</h3>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {product.locationStocks.length ? (
                        <div className="overview-location-list">
                          {product.locationStocks.map(stock => (
                            <div className="overview-location-item" key={stock.locationId} data-testid={`overview-product-location-${stock.locationId}`}>
                              <span className="overview-line-icon"><MapPin size={15} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
                              <span className="overview-line-copy">
                                <strong>{stock.locationName}</strong>
                                <small>{stock.warehouseName}</small>
                              </span>
                              <span className="overview-line-quantity">{numberText(stock.quantity)} {unitLooksLikeQuantity(product.unit) ? '' : product.unit}</span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="overview-drawer-muted">No stock has been recorded at a location yet.</p>
                      )}
                    </section>
                  </div>

                  <div className="overview-drawer-footer">
                    <Link href={`/products/${product.id}`} className="btn btn-primary overview-product-full-link" data-testid="link-drawer-full-product">
                      View product details <ArrowUpRight size={15} />
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </>
              )
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

export function unitLooksLikeQuantity(unit: string): boolean {
  return /^[\d.,\s]+$/.test(unit.trim());
}

export function formatSellingPrice(amount: number, currencyCode: string): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: currencyCode,
    currencyDisplay: 'code',
  }).format(amount);
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/product-form.tsx
==========================================================================================
import { useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useListCategories, type Product, type ProductInput, type ProductUpdate } from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { Field, Modal } from './common';
import { ProductLocationPicker } from './product-location-picker';

const currencyNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'currency' });
const currencyCodes = Intl.supportedValuesOf('currency');
const featured = ['USD', 'INR', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'AED', 'CAD', 'AUD'];
const currencies = [
  ...featured.filter(code => currencyCodes.includes(code)),
  ...currencyCodes.filter(code => !featured.includes(code)).sort((a, b) =>
    (currencyNames.of(a) || a).localeCompare(currencyNames.of(b) || b)),
];

export function ProductForm({ product, onClose, onSave, busy, error }: { product?: Product; onClose: () => void; onSave: (data: ProductInput | ProductUpdate) => void; busy: boolean; error?: string }) {
  const categories = useListCategories();
  const [name, setName] = useState(product?.name || '');
  const [sku, setSku] = useState(product?.sku || '');
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState(product?.categoryId?.toString() || '');
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState(product?.unit || '');
  const [reorderPoint, setReorderPoint] = useState(String(product?.reorderPoint ?? 0));
  const [currencyCode, setCurrencyCode] = useState(product?.currencyCode || 'USD');
  const [sellingPrice, setSellingPrice] = useState(product?.sellingPrice == null ? '' : String(product.sellingPrice));
  const [initialStock, setInitialStock] = useState('');
  const [defaultLocationId, setDefaultLocationId] = useState<number | null>(product?.defaultLocationId ?? null);
  const [validation, setValidation] = useState('');
  const [locationPending, setLocationPending] = useState(false);
  const locationPendingRef = useRef(false);
  const onLocationPendingChange = (pending: boolean) => {
    locationPendingRef.current = pending;
    setLocationPending(pending);
  };

  const submit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (locationPendingRef.current) {
      setValidation('Wait for the location to finish saving before saving the product.');
      return;
    }
    const openingQuantity = initialStock.trim() === '' ? 0 : Number(initialStock);
    if (/^[\d.,\s]+$/.test(unit.trim())) {
      setValidation('Unit of measure should be a name such as pieces, boxes, or kg. Enter stock quantities in the quantity field.');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(openingQuantity) || openingQuantity < 0 ||
      openingQuantity > 100_000_000 || Math.round(openingQuantity * 1_000_000) / 1_000_000 !== openingQuantity) {
      setValidation('Opening stock must be from 0 to 100,000,000 with at most six decimal places.');
      return;
    }
    if (!product && openingQuantity > 0 && defaultLocationId === null) {
      setValidation('Choose a default storage location before adding opening stock.');
      return;
    }
    const price = sellingPrice.trim() === '' ? null : Number(sellingPrice);
    const digits = new Intl.NumberFormat('en', { style: 'currency', currency: currencyCode }).resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits ?? 2;
    const factor = 10 ** digits;
    if (price !== null && (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0 || price > 1_000_000 || Math.round(price * factor) / factor !== price)) {
      setValidation(`Enter a ${currencyCode} price from 0 to 1,000,000 with no more than ${digits} decimal places.`);
      return;
    }
    setValidation('');
    const data = {
      name: name.trim(),
      sku: sku.trim(),
      categoryId: categoryId ? Number(categoryId) : null,
      defaultLocationId,
      unit: unit.trim() || 'units',
      reorderPoint: Number(reorderPoint),
      sellingPrice: price,
      currencyCode,
    };
    onSave(product ? data : { ...data, ...(openingQuantity > 0 ? { initialStock: openingQuantity, initialLocationId: defaultLocationId } : {}) });
  };

  return <Modal title={product ? 'Edit product' : 'New product'} onClose={onClose}>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <div className="grid-fields">
        <Field label="Product name *"><input className="field" required value={name} onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Pallet wrap" data-testid="input-product-name" /></Field>
        <Field label="SKU *"><input className="field mono" required value={sku} onChange={event => setSku(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. WRAP-001" data-testid="input-product-sku" /></Field>
        <Field label="Category"><select className="field" value={categoryId} onChange={event => setCategoryId(event.target.value)} data-testid="select-product-category"><option value="">Uncategorized</option>{categories.data?.map(category => <option key={category.id} value={category.id}>{category.name}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label="Unit of measure (e.g. pieces, boxes, kg)"><input className="field" value={unit} onChange={event => setUnit(event.target.value)} placeholder="units" data-testid="input-product-unit" /></Field>
        <Field label="Reorder point"><input className="field" type="number" min="0" required value={reorderPoint} onChange={event => setReorderPoint(event.target.value)} data-testid="input-reorder-point" /></Field>
        <Field label="Selling price currency"><select className="field" value={currencyCode} onChange={event => { setCurrencyCode(event.target.value); setSellingPrice(''); setValidation(''); }} data-testid="select-product-currency">{currencies.map(code => <option value={code} key={code}>{code} — {currencyNames.of(code) || code}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <Field label={`Your selling price (${currencyCode}, per unit)`}><input className="field" type="number" min="0" step="any" inputMode="decimal" value={sellingPrice} onChange={event => setSellingPrice(event.target.value)} placeholder="Optional · e.g. 24.99" data-testid="input-product-selling-price" /></Field>
        {!product && <Field label="Opening stock quantity (optional)"><input className="field" type="number" min="0" step="any" value={initialStock} onChange={event => setInitialStock(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 20000" data-testid="input-initial-stock" /></Field>}
      </div>
      <p className="location-note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Changing currency clears the entered price; no exchange-rate conversion is made. A unit is a label (pieces, boxes, kg), not your stock quantity.</p>
      <ProductLocationPicker value={defaultLocationId} onChange={id => { setDefaultLocationId(id); setValidation(''); }} onCreationPendingChange={onLocationPendingChange} />
      {!product && <p className="location-note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>If you add opening stock, it will be recorded at the selected default location.</p>}
      {product && <p className="location-note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Editing a product does not change stock already on hand. To add stock to an existing product, create a receipt from Operations.</p>}
      {(validation || error) && <p className="location-error" role="alert" data-testid="status-form-error">{validation || error}</p>}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 9, marginTop: 25, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}><button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button><button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy || locationPending} type="submit" data-testid="button-save-product">{busy ? 'Saving…' : locationPending ? 'Saving location…' : product ? 'Save changes' : 'Create product'}</button></div>
    </form>
  </Modal>;
}

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/product-location-picker.tsx
==========================================================================================
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'wouter';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCreateLocation, useListLocations, useListWarehouses, getListLocationsQueryKey, type Location } from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { ArrowUpRight, Crosshair, MapPin, Plus, Search, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Field } from './common';
import { GooglePlacePicker, type ConfirmedGoogleSelection } from './google-place-picker';

type Coordinates = { latitude: number; longitude: number };

export function ProductLocationPicker({ value, onChange, onCreationPendingChange }: { value: number | null; onChange: (id: number | null) => void; onCreationPendingChange: (pending: boolean) => void }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const locations = useListLocations();
  const warehouses = useListWarehouses();
  const create = useCreateLocation();
  const [newLocation, setNewLocation] = useState<Location | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [address, setAddress] = useState('');
  const [coordinates, setCoordinates] = useState<Coordinates | null>(null);
  const [mapQuery, setMapQuery] = useState('');
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [googleSelection, setGoogleSelection] = useState<ConfirmedGoogleSelection | null>(null);
  const creatingRef = useRef(false);
  const confirmedRef = useRef(false);
  const clearGoogleSelection = useCallback(() => {
    if (confirmedRef.current) {
      setAddress('');
      setCoordinates(null);
      setMapQuery('');
    }
    confirmedRef.current = false;
    setGoogleSelection(null);
  }, []);

  const options = locations.data ?? [];
  const selected = options.find(location => location.id === value) ?? (newLocation?.id === value ? newLocation : null);
  const searchAddress = () => {
    if (!address.trim()) { setError('Enter an address to search on the map.'); return; }
    setMapQuery(address.trim());
    setError('');
  };
  const useCurrentLocation = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) { setError('Your browser does not support location sharing. You can still type an address.'); return; }
    setError('');
    setLocating(true);
    clearGoogleSelection();
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      position => {
        const next = { latitude: position.coords.latitude, longitude: position.coords.longitude };
        setCoordinates(next);
        setAddress('');
        setMapQuery(`${next.latitude},${next.longitude}`);
        setLocating(false);
      },
      geoError => {
        setLocating(false);
        setError(geoError.code === 1 ? 'Location permission was denied. You can type an address instead.' : 'Could not find your location. Try again or type an address.');
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: false, timeout: 12000 }
    );
  };
  const saveLocation = () => {
    if (creatingRef.current) return;
    if (!warehouseId || !name.trim() || !code.trim()) {
      setError('Choose a warehouse and enter a location name and code.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    creatingRef.current = true;
    onCreationPendingChange(true);
    create.mutate({
      data: {
        warehouseId: Number(warehouseId),
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim(),
        kind: 'internal',
        parentId: null,
        address: googleSelection?.result.address ?? (address.trim() || null),
        latitude: googleSelection?.result.latitude ?? coordinates?.latitude ?? null,
        longitude: googleSelection?.result.longitude ?? coordinates?.longitude ?? null,
        ...(!googleSelection ? {} : 'placeId' in googleSelection.source
          ? { googlePlaceId: googleSelection.source.placeId }
          : { googlePin: googleSelection.source.pin }),
      },
    }, {
      onSuccess: location => {
        setNewLocation(location);
        onChange(location.id);
        setExpanded(false);
        confirmedRef.current = false;
        setGoogleSelection(null);
        setAddress('');
        setCoordinates(null);
        setMapQuery('');
        setName('');
        setCode('');
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListLocationsQueryKey() });
      },
      onError: reason => setError(String(reason)),
      onSettled: () => {
        creatingRef.current = false;
        onCreationPendingChange(false);
      },
    });
  };

  return <section className="product-location" aria-labelledby="product-location-title">
    <div className="product-location-heading">
      <span className="product-location-icon"><MapPin size={18} /></span>
      <div><h3 id="product-location-title">Default storage location</h3><p>Choose where this product normally belongs. This does not move stock already on hand.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div className="location-choice">
      <Field label="Saved location">
        <select className="field" aria-label="Saved default storage location" value={value ?? ''} onChange={event => onChange(event.target.value ? Number(event.target.value) : null)} data-testid="select-product-default-location">
          <option value="">No default location</option>
          {newLocation && !options.some(location => location.id === newLocation.id) && <option value={newLocation.id}>{newLocation.warehouseName} / {newLocation.name}</option>}
          {options.map(location => <option key={location.id} value={location.id}>{location.warehouseName} / {location.name}</option>)}
        </select>
      </Field>
      <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => { setExpanded(!expanded); setError(''); }} aria-expanded={expanded} data-testid="button-add-product-location">
        {expanded ? <X size={15} /> : <Plus size={15} />}{expanded ? 'Close' : 'Add a location'}
      </button>
    </div>
    {locations.isLoading && <p className="location-note" role="status">Loading saved locations…</p>}
    {locations.isError && <p className="location-error" role="alert">Saved locations could not be loaded. <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => locations.refetch()}>Retry</button></p>}
    {selected && !expanded && <div className="location-selected" data-testid="text-selected-product-location"><strong>{selected.warehouseName} / {selected.name}</strong>{selected.address ? ` · ${selected.address}` : ''}</div>}
    {expanded && <div className="location-create" onKeyDown={event => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.closest('.google-place-picker')) return;
      if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!create.isPending && warehouses.data?.length) saveLocation();
      }
    }}>
      <h4 className="location-create-title">Add your own storage place</h4>
      {warehouses.isLoading ? <p className="location-note" role="status">Loading warehouses…</p> : warehouses.isError ? <p className="location-error" role="alert">Warehouses could not be loaded. <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => warehouses.refetch()}>Retry</button></p> : !warehouses.data?.length ? <p className="location-note">A location needs a warehouse first. <Link href="/settings?add=warehouse" style={{ color: '#205856', fontWeight: 700, textDecoration: 'underline' }} data-testid="link-create-warehouse">Create a warehouse in Settings</Link>, then come back here.</p> : <>
        <div className="grid-fields">
          <Field label="Warehouse *"><select className="field" value={warehouseId} onChange={event => setWarehouseId(event.target.value)} aria-label="Warehouse for new location" data-testid="select-new-location-warehouse"><option value="">Choose warehouse</option>{warehouses.data.map(warehouse => <option value={warehouse.id} key={warehouse.id}>{warehouse.name}</option>)}</select></Field>
          <Field label="Location name *"><input className="field" value={name} onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. North storage room" aria-label="New location name" data-testid="input-new-location-name" /></Field>
          <Field label="Location code *"><input className="field mono" value={code} onChange={event => setCode(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. NORTH-01" aria-label="New location code" data-testid="input-new-location-code" /></Field>
        </div>
        <div className="location-address"><Field label="Street address (optional)"><input className="field" value={address} onChange={event => { clearGoogleSelection(); setAddress(event.target.value); setCoordinates(null); setMapQuery(''); }} placeholder="Street, city, and postal code" aria-label="New location street address" data-testid="input-new-location-address" /></Field></div>
        <p className="location-note">Type an address to save it as written, or choose and confirm a Google result below. Typed addresses are not Google-verified.</p>
        <GooglePlacePicker onEdit={clearGoogleSelection} onConfirm={selection => { confirmedRef.current = true; setGoogleSelection(selection); setAddress(selection.result.address); setCoordinates({ latitude: selection.result.latitude, longitude: selection.result.longitude }); setMapQuery(''); setError(''); }} />
        {googleSelection && <p className="location-selected" role="status">Google place confirmed for this form: {googleSelection.result.address}. Save & select location to store it.</p>}
        <div className="location-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-soft" onClick={searchAddress} data-testid="button-search-location-map"><Search size={15} />Search on map</button>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={useCurrentLocation} disabled={locating} data-testid="button-use-current-location"><Crosshair size={15} />{locating ? 'Finding location…' : 'Use my current location'}</button>
          {mapQuery && <a className="btn btn-outline" href={`https://maps.google.com/maps?q=${encodeURIComponent(mapQuery)}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-testid="link-open-location-google-maps">Open in Google Maps <ArrowUpRight size={14} /></a>}
        </div>
        {coordinates && !googleSelection && <p className="location-note" data-testid="text-location-coordinates">Coordinates ready to save: {coordinates.latitude.toFixed(5)}, {coordinates.longitude.toFixed(5)}. A street address is not filled in automatically.</p>}
        {mapQuery && <div className="location-map"><iframe title="Google Maps preview of the searched place" loading="lazy" referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade" src={`https://maps.google.com/maps?q=${encodeURIComponent(mapQuery)}&output=embed`} /><div className="location-map-caption">Map preview only. Check that this is the place you meant.</div></div>}
        {error && <p className="location-error" role="alert" data-testid="status-location-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="location-create-footer"><p className="location-note">Save this place first, then save the product. No stock is moved by adding a location.</p><button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={saveLocation} disabled={create.isPending} data-testid="button-save-new-location">{create.isPending ? 'Saving location…' : 'Save & select location'}</button></div>
      </>}
      {(!warehouses.data?.length || warehouses.isError) && error && <p className="location-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </div>}
  </section>;
}

import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';

const buttonGroupVariants = cva(
  "flex w-fit items-stretch has-[>[data-slot=button-group]]:gap-2 [&>*]:focus-visible:relative [&>*]:focus-visible:z-10 has-[select[aria-hidden=true]:last-child]:[&>[data-slot=select-trigger]:last-of-type]:rounded-r-md [&>[data-slot=select-trigger]:not([class*='w-'])]:w-fit [&>input]:flex-1",
  {
    variants: {
      orientation: {
        horizontal:
          '[&>*:not(:first-child)]:rounded-l-none [&>*:not(:first-child)]:border-l-0 [&>*:not(:last-child)]:rounded-r-none',
        vertical:
          'flex-col [&>*:not(:first-child)]:rounded-t-none [&>*:not(:first-child)]:border-t-0 [&>*:not(:last-child)]:rounded-b-none',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      orientation: 'horizontal',
    },
  },
);

function ButtonGroup({
  className,
  orientation,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & VariantProps<typeof buttonGroupVariants>) {
  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      data-slot="button-group"
      data-orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(buttonGroupVariants({ orientation }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function ButtonGroupText({
  className,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
  asChild?: boolean;
}) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'div';

  return (
    <Comp
      className={cn(
        "bg-muted shadow-xs flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-4 text-sm font-medium [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function ButtonGroupSeparator({
  className,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Separator>) {
  return (
    <Separator
      data-slot="button-group-separator"
      orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(
        'bg-input relative !m-0 self-stretch data-[orientation=vertical]:h-auto',
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export {
  ButtonGroup,
  ButtonGroupSeparator,
  ButtonGroupText,
  buttonGroupVariants,

FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/components/ui/button.tsx

import * as React from 'react';
import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';

const buttonVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0' +
    ' hover-elevate active-elevate-2',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          // @replit: no hover, and add primary border
          'bg-primary text-primary-foreground border border-primary-border',
        destructive:
          'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground shadow-sm border-destructive-border',
        outline:
          // @replit Shows the background color of whatever card / sidebar / accent background it is inside of.
          // Inherits the current text color. Uses shadow-xs. no shadow on active
          // No hover state
          ' border [border-color:var(--button-outline)] shadow-xs active:shadow-none ',
        secondary:
          // @replit border, no hover, no shadow, secondary border.
          'border bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground border border-secondary-border ',
        // @replit no hover, transparent border
        ghost: 'border border-transparent',
        link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
      },
      size: {
        // @replit changed sizes
        default: 'min-h-9 px-4 py-2',
        sm: 'min-h-8 rounded-md px-3 text-xs',
        lg: 'min-h-10 rounded-md px-8',
        icon: 'h-9 w-9',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
      size: 'default',
    },
  },
);

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
    return (
      <Comp
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
Button.displayName = 'Button';

export { Button, buttonVariants };

function CalendarDayButton({
  className,
  day,
  modifiers,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DayButton>) {
  const defaultClassNames = getDefaultClassNames();

  const ref = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (modifiers.focused) ref.current?.focus();
  }, [modifiers.focused]);

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      data-day={day.date.toLocaleDateString()}
      data-selected-single={
        modifiers.selected &&
        !modifiers.range_start &&
        !modifiers.range_end &&
        !modifiers.range_middle
      }
      data-range-start={modifiers.range_start}
      data-range-end={modifiers.range_end}
      data-range-middle={modifiers.range_middle}
      className={cn(
        'data-[selected-single=true]:bg-primary data-[selected-single=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[range-middle=true]:bg-accent data-[range-middle=true]:text-accent-foreground data-[range-start=true]:bg-primary data-[range-start=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[range-end=true]:bg-primary data-[range-end=true]:text-primary-foreground group-data-[focused=true]/day:border-ring group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-ring/50 flex aspect-square h-auto w-full min-w-[--cell-size] flex-col gap-1 font-normal leading-none data-[range-end=true]:rounded-md data-[range-middle=true]:rounded-none data-[range-start=true]:rounded-md group-data-[focused=true]/day:relative group-data-[focused=true]/day:z-10 group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-[3px] [&>span]:text-xs [&>span]:opacity-70',
        defaultClassNames.day,
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
