FILE: artifacts/stocksense/src/pages/operation-detail.tsx
==========================================================================================
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams, useLocation } from 'wouter';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  useGetOperation,
  useUpdateOperation,
  useDeleteOperation,
  useValidateOperation,
  useCancelOperation,
  getGetOperationQueryKey,
  getListOperationsQueryKey,
  getGetDashboardQueryKey,
  getListProductsQueryKey,
  getListMovesQueryKey,
  type OperationUpdate,
  type OperationStatus,
} from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { ArrowLeft, Pencil, Trash2, Check, Ban, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Shell, LoadingRows, QueryError, Status, Confirm, numberText, dateText } from '../components/common';
import { OperationForm } from '../components/operation-form';
import { DeliveryProgress } from '../components/delivery-progress';
import './operation-detail.css';

export default function OperationDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const opId = Number(id);
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const q = useGetOperation(opId);
  const update = useUpdateOperation();
  const remove = useDeleteOperation();
  const validate = useValidateOperation();
  const cancel = useCancelOperation();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<'delete' | 'cancel' | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const refresh = () => {
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetOperationQueryKey(opId) });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListOperationsQueryKey() });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetDashboardQueryKey() });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListProductsQueryKey() });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListMovesQueryKey() });
  };
  const edit = (data: OperationUpdate) =>
    update.mutate(
      { id: opId, data },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refresh();
          setEditing(false);
          setError('');
        },
        onError: e => setError(String(e)),
      },
    );
  const status = (value: OperationStatus) =>
    update.mutate(
      { id: opId, data: { status: value } },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refresh();
          setError('');
        },
        onError: e => setError(String(e)),
      },
    );
  const validateNow = () =>
    validate.mutate(
      { id: opId },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refresh();
          setError('');
        },
        onError: e => setError(String(e)),
      },
    );
  const cancelNow = () =>
    cancel.mutate(
      { id: opId },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refresh();
          setConfirm(null);
          setError('');
        },
        onError: e => {
          setConfirm(null);
          setError(String(e));
        },
      },
    );
  const deleteNow = () =>
    remove.mutate(
      { id: opId },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          refresh();
          navigate('/operations');
        },
        onError: e => {
          setConfirm(null);
          setError(String(e));
        },
      },
    );

  const op = q.data;
  const editable = op?.status === 'draft' || op?.status === 'waiting' || op?.status === 'ready';

  return (
    <Shell title="Operation details">
      <main className="page operation-detail">
        <Link
          href="/operations"
          className="btn btn-outline operation-detail-back"
          data-testid="link-back-operations"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={15} /> All operations
        </Link>

        {q.isLoading ? (
          <LoadingRows />
        ) : q.isError ? (
          <QueryError retry={() => q.refetch()} />
        ) : (
          op && (
            <>
              <header className="operation-detail-header">
                <div className="operation-detail-identity">
                  <div className="eyebrow">OPERATION / {op.type.toUpperCase()}</div>
                  <h1 className="page-title mono operation-detail-reference">{op.reference}</h1>
                  <div className="operation-detail-created">
                    <Status
                      value={op.status}
                      label={
                        op.type === 'delivery' && op.deliveryCompletedAt
                          ? 'Delivery done'
                          : op.type === 'delivery' && op.deliveryStartedAt
                            ? 'In transit'
                            : op.type === 'delivery' && op.status === 'waiting'
                          ? 'Picked'
                          : op.type === 'delivery' && op.status === 'ready'
                            ? 'Packed'
                            : undefined
                      }
                    />
                    <span className="subtle operation-detail-created-date">
                      Created {dateText(op.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="operation-detail-actions">
                  {editable && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-outline"
                      onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
                      data-testid="button-edit-operation"
                    >
                      <Pencil size={15} /> Edit
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {editable && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-danger"
                      onClick={() => setConfirm('cancel')}
                      data-testid="button-cancel-operation"
                    >
                      <Ban size={15} /> Cancel
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {op.status === 'draft' && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-outline"
                      onClick={() => setConfirm('delete')}
                      data-testid="button-delete-operation"
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={15} /> Delete
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </header>

              {error && (
                <div
                  className="panel panel-pad operation-detail-error"
                  data-testid="status-operation-error"
                >
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="operation-detail-grid">
                <div className="operation-detail-primary">
                  <section className="panel operation-detail-lines">
                    <div className="operation-detail-section-heading">
                      <div className="eyebrow">MOVEMENT DETAILS</div>
                      <h2 className="display">Items in this {op.type}</h2>
                    </div>

                    <div className="table-wrap operation-detail-table-wrap">
                      <table className="data-table operation-detail-table">
                        <thead>
                          <tr>
                            <th>Product</th>
                            <th>SKU</th>
                            <th>{op.type === 'adjustment' ? 'Counted quantity' : 'Quantity'}</th>
                            <th>Unit of measure</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {op.lines.map(line => (
                            <tr key={line.id}>
                              <td>
                                <Link
                                  href={`/products/${line.productId}`}
                                  className="operation-detail-product-link"
                                  data-testid={`link-line-product-${line.productId}`}
                                >
                                  {line.productName}
                                </Link>
                              </td>
                              <td className="mono subtle">{line.sku}</td>
                              <td>
                                <strong className="mono">
                                  {numberText(
                                    op.type === 'adjustment'
                                      ? line.countedQuantity ?? 0
                                      : line.quantity,
                                  )}
                                </strong>
                              </td>
                              <td className="subtle">{line.unit}</td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>

                    <div className="operation-detail-mobile-lines" aria-label="Operation products">
                      {op.lines.map(line => (
                        <article className="operation-detail-product-card" key={line.id}>
                          <div className="operation-detail-product-field">
                            <span className="operation-detail-field-label">Product</span>
                            <Link
                              href={`/products/${line.productId}`}
                              className="operation-detail-product-link"
                              data-testid={`link-line-product-mobile-${line.productId}`}
                            >
                              {line.productName}
                            </Link>
                          </div>
                          <div className="operation-detail-product-meta">
                            <div className="operation-detail-product-field">
                              <span className="operation-detail-field-label">SKU</span>
                              <span className="mono">{line.sku}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="operation-detail-product-field">
                              <span className="operation-detail-field-label">
                                {op.type === 'adjustment' ? 'Counted quantity' : 'Quantity'}
                              </span>
                              <span>
                                <strong className="mono">
                                  {numberText(
                                    op.type === 'adjustment'
                                      ? line.countedQuantity ?? 0
                                      : line.quantity,
                                  )}
                                </strong>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="operation-detail-product-field">
                              <span className="operation-detail-field-label">Unit of measure</span>
                              <span className="subtle">{line.unit}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </article>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="panel panel-pad operation-detail-routing">
                    <div className="eyebrow">{op.type === 'adjustment' ? 'STOCK COUNT LOCATION' : 'ROUTING'}</div>
                    <div className="operation-detail-route">
                      {op.type === 'adjustment' ? (
                        <div className="operation-detail-route-stop">
                          <small className="subtle">Counted at</small>
                          <div className="operation-detail-value">{op.sourceLocationName || op.destinationLocationName || 'Unknown location'}</div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                      <div className="operation-detail-route-stop">
                        <small className="subtle">From</small>
                        <div className="operation-detail-value">
                          {op.sourceLocationName || 'External'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ArrowRight
                        className="operation-detail-route-arrow"
                        size={19}
                        color="#7da397"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      />
                      <div className="operation-detail-route-stop">
                        <small className="subtle">To</small>
                        <div className="operation-detail-value">
                          {op.destinationLocationName || 'External'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="operation-detail-route-meta">
                      <div>
                        <span className="subtle">Contact</span>
                        <div className="operation-detail-value">{op.contact || '—'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="subtle">Scheduled</span>
                        <div className="operation-detail-value">{dateText(op.scheduledAt)}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>
                  <DeliveryProgress operation={op} />
                </div>

                <aside className="panel panel-pad operation-detail-workflow">
                  <div className="eyebrow">WORKFLOW</div>
                  <h2 className="display">Move it forward</h2>
                  <p className="operation-detail-workflow-copy">
                    {op.status === 'done'
                      ? 'Stock movement recorded. Delivery tracking continues separately below the route.'
                      : 'Review the lines and locations, then validate to record the stock movement.'}
                  </p>
                  <div className="operation-detail-progress">
                    {['draft', 'waiting', 'ready', 'done'].map((s, i) => (
                      <div key={s} className="operation-detail-progress-step">
                        <div
                          className="operation-detail-progress-bar"
                          style={{
                            background:
                              ['draft', 'waiting', 'ready', 'done'].indexOf(op.status) >= i
                                ? '#2b7569'
                                : '#bfd3c0',
                          }}
                        />
                        <small>
                          {op.type === 'delivery' && s === 'waiting'
                            ? 'picked'
                            : op.type === 'delivery' && s === 'ready'
                              ? 'packed'
                              : s}
                        </small>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {op.status === 'draft' && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-outline operation-detail-workflow-button"
                      disabled={update.isPending}
                      onClick={() => status('waiting')}
                      data-testid="button-mark-waiting"
                    >
                      {op.type === 'delivery' ? 'Mark as picked' : 'Mark as waiting'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {(op.status === 'draft' || op.status === 'waiting') && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-outline operation-detail-workflow-button"
                      disabled={update.isPending}
                      onClick={() => status('ready')}
                      data-testid="button-mark-ready"
                    >
                      {op.type === 'delivery' ? 'Mark as packed' : 'Mark as ready'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {editable && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-primary operation-detail-workflow-button"
                      disabled={validate.isPending}
                      onClick={validateNow}
                      data-testid="button-validate-operation"
                    >
                      <Check size={16} />
                      {validate.isPending ? 'Validating…' : 'Validate movement'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {!editable && op.type !== 'delivery' && (
                    <p className="operation-detail-locked">
                      This operation is {op.status}. No further changes can be made.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </aside>
              </div>
            </>
          )
        )}

        {editing && op && (
          <OperationForm
            operation={op}
            onClose={() => setEditing(false)}
            onSave={data => edit(data as OperationUpdate)}
            busy={update.isPending}
            error={error}
          />
        )}
        {confirm && (
          <Confirm
            title={confirm === 'delete' ? 'Delete draft?' : 'Cancel operation?'}
            description={
              confirm === 'delete'
                ? 'This draft will be permanently removed.'
                : 'This operation will be canceled and can no longer be validated.'
            }
            onClose={() => setConfirm(null)}
            onConfirm={confirm === 'delete' ? deleteNow : cancelNow}
            busy={remove.isPending || cancel.isPending}
          />
        )}
      </main>
    </Shell>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams, useLocation } from 'wouter';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useGetProduct, useListLocations, useUpdateProduct, useDeleteProduct, getGetProductQueryKey, getListProductsQueryKey, getGetDashboardQueryKey, type ProductUpdate } from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowUpRight, Pencil, Trash2, MapPin, Package } from 'lucide-react';
import { Shell, LoadingRows, QueryError, Status, Confirm, numberText, dateText } from '../components/common';
import { ProductForm } from '../components/product-form';
import { formatSellingPrice, unitLooksLikeQuantity } from '../components/product-display';

export default function ProductDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const productId = Number(id);
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const q = useGetProduct(productId);
  const locations = useListLocations();
  const update = useUpdateProduct();
  const remove = useDeleteProduct();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const save = (data: ProductUpdate) => update.mutate({ id: productId, data }, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetProductQueryKey(productId) });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListProductsQueryKey() });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetDashboardQueryKey() });
      setEditing(false);
      setError('');
    },
    onError: reason => setError(String(reason)),
  });
  const del = () => remove.mutate({ id: productId }, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListProductsQueryKey() });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getGetDashboardQueryKey() });
      navigate('/products');
    },
    onError: reason => { setDeleting(false); setError(String(reason)); },
  });
  const product = q.data;
  const needsUnitCorrection = !!product && unitLooksLikeQuantity(product.unit);
  const defaultLocation = locations.data?.find(location => location.id === product?.defaultLocationId);
  const mapQuery = defaultLocation?.latitude != null && defaultLocation.longitude != null
    ? `${defaultLocation.latitude},${defaultLocation.longitude}`
    : defaultLocation?.address?.trim();

  return <Shell title="Product details"><main className="page">
    <Link href="/products" className="btn btn-outline" style={{ marginBottom: 30 }} data-testid="link-back-products"><ArrowLeft size={15} /> All products</Link>
    {q.isLoading ? <LoadingRows /> : q.isError ? <QueryError retry={() => q.refetch()} /> : product && <>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'start', gap: 20, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 29 }}>
        <div><div className="eyebrow">PRODUCT / <span className="mono">{product.sku}</span></div><h1 className="page-title">{product.name}</h1><div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginTop: 14 }}><Status value={product.stockStatus} /><span className="subtle" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{product.categoryName || 'Uncategorized'} · Created {dateText(product.createdAt)}</span></div></div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 9 }}><button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => { setError(''); setEditing(true); }} data-testid="button-edit-product"><Pencil size={15} /> Edit</button><button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => setDeleting(true)} data-testid="button-delete-product"><Trash2 size={15} /> Archive</button></div>
      </div>
      {error && <p style={{ color: '#a34432' }} data-testid="status-product-error">{error}</p>}
      {needsUnitCorrection && <div className="panel panel-pad" role="status" style={{ marginBottom: 20, borderColor: '#e4b96b', background: '#fff9ec' }} data-testid="notice-numeric-unit">
        <strong>“{product.unit}” is saved as the unit label, not stock.</strong> Your recorded stock is {numberText(product.totalStock)}. Use Edit to change the unit to “pieces” or “boxes”, then record the actual quantity with a receipt.
      </div>}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr))', gap: 15, marginBottom: 23 }}>
        {[{ label: 'Total on hand', value: numberText(product.totalStock), suffix: needsUnitCorrection ? '' : product.unit }, { label: 'Reorder point', value: numberText(product.reorderPoint), suffix: needsUnitCorrection ? '' : product.unit }, { label: 'Locations carrying stock', value: String(product.locationStocks.length), suffix: 'locations' }].map(item => <div className="panel panel-pad" key={item.label}><div className="eyebrow">{item.label}</div><div className="display" style={{ fontSize: 38, marginTop: 15 }}>{item.value} <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#6c8880', letterSpacing: 0 }}>{item.suffix}</span></div></div>)}
      </div>
      {product.sellingPrice !== null && <p className="subtle" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: '-8px 0 23px' }}>Optional price set for this product: {formatSellingPrice(product.sellingPrice, product.currencyCode)} per unit. This does not publish it for sale.</p>}
      <section className="panel panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 23, background: '#f2f7f0' }} aria-label="Default storage location">
        <div className="eyebrow">PRODUCT SETUP / DEFAULT LOCATION</div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 11, marginTop: 12 }}><MapPin size={19} color="#408078" /><strong data-testid="text-product-default-location">{product.defaultLocationName ? `${product.defaultWarehouseName} / ${product.defaultLocationName}` : 'No default location set'}</strong></div>
        {defaultLocation?.address && <p className="subtle" style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '8px 0 0 30px' }} data-testid="text-product-default-address">{defaultLocation.address}</p>}
        {mapQuery && <a className="btn btn-soft" href={`https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(mapQuery)}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ marginTop: 12 }} data-testid="link-product-default-map">View on Google Maps <ArrowUpRight size={14} /></a>}
        <p className="subtle" style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.6, margin: '10px 0 0' }}>This is where the product normally belongs. It is not a count of stock here; changing it does not move existing stock.</p>
      </section>
      <section className="panel"><div style={{ padding: 24, borderBottom: '1px solid #dce6dc' }}><div className="eyebrow">ACTUAL STOCK / LOCATION BREAKDOWN</div><h2 className="display" style={{ fontSize: 22, margin: '6px 0 0' }}>Where stock is recorded</h2></div>
         {product.locationStocks.length === 0 ? <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: '#66827a' }}><Package size={23} style={{ margin: 'auto' }} /><p>No stock has been recorded for this product yet. A default location is not a stock count. '' : product.unit}</span></td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>}
      </section>
    </>}
    {editing && product && <ProductForm product={product} onClose={() => setEditing(false)} onSave={data => save(data as ProductUpdate)} busy={update.isPending} error={error} />}
    {deleting && <Confirm title="Archive product?" description="This archives the product and removes it from your active catalog. Products with remaining positive stock cannot be archived; prior stock history does not prevent archiving." onClose={() => setDeleting(false)} onConfirm={del} busy={remove.isPending} />}
  </main></Shell>;
}

  const selectTab=(next:Tab)=>{setTab(next);setEditing(null);setAdding(false);setError('')};
  const createWarehouseFromLocations=()=>{selectTab('warehouses');open()};
 const success=()=>{refresh();close()};const failure=(e:unknown)=>setError(String(e));
 const submit=(e:FormEvent)=>{e.preventDefault();if(tab==='warehouses'){const data={name:name.trim(),code:code.trim(),address:address.trim()||null};if(editing)uw.mutate({id:editing.id,data},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure});else cw.mutate({data},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure})}
  else if(tab==='locations'){if(!warehouse){setError('Choose a warehouse.');return}const locationAddress=address.trim()||null;const addressChanged=editing&&'warehouseId'in editing&&locationAddress!==editing.address;const data={name:name.trim(),code:code.trim(),warehouseId:Number(warehouse),parentId:parent?Number(parent):null,kind,address:locationAddress};if(editing)ul.mutate({id:editing.id,data:{name:data.name,code:data.code,parentId:data.parentId,kind:data.kind,address:locationAddress,...(addressChanged?{latitude:null,longitude:null}:{})}},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure});else cl.mutate({data},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure})}
 else {const data={name:name.trim(),color};if(editing)uc.mutate({id:editing.id,data},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure});else cc.mutate({data},{onSuccess:success,onError:failure})}};
 const remove=()=>{if(deleting===null)return;const options={onSuccess:()=>{refresh();setDeleting(null);setError('')},onError:(e:unknown)=>{setDeleting(null);setError(String(e))}};if(tab==='warehouses')dw.mutate({id:deleting},options);else if(tab==='locations')dl.mutate({id:deleting},options);else dc.mutate({id:deleting},options)};
 const busy=cw.isPending||uw.isPending||cl.isPending||ul.isPending||cc.isPending||uc.isPending;
 const q=tab==='warehouses'?wh:tab==='locations'?loc:cat;
 const itemName=tab==='categories'?'category':tab.slice(0,-1);
  const noWarehousesForLocations=tab==='locations'&&!wh.isLoading&&!wh.isError&&!wh.data?.length;
  const emptyDescription=tab==='warehouses'
    ?'Create a warehouse to choose where your stock is stored.'
    :tab==='locations'
      ?noWarehousesForLocations?'Create a warehouse first. Then add locations inside it to organize where stock is kept.':'Add locations inside a warehouse to organize where stock is kept.'
      :'Create categories to group products and make the catalog easier to browse.';
    return <Shell title="Settings"><main className="page"><PageHeading eyebrow="WORKSPACE STRUCTURE" title="Settings" description="Keep your warehouses, storage locations, and product categories organized."/><div className="pill-tabs" style={{width:'fit-content',marginBottom:22}}>{(['warehouses','locations','categories'] as Tab[]).map(x=><button className={`pill-tab ${tab===x?'active':''}`} onClick={()=>selectTab(x)} key={x} data-testid={`button-tab-${x}`}>{x.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+x.slice(1)}</button>)}</div>{error&&!adding&&!editing&&<p style={{color:'#a34432'}} data-testid="status-settings-error">{error}</p>}<section className="panel"><div style={{display:'flex',justifyContent:'space-between',alignItems:'center',padding:24,borderBottom:'1px solid #dce6dc',gap:12,flexWrap:'wrap'}}><div><div className="eyebrow">WORKSPACE / {tab.toUpperCase()}</div><h2 className="display" style={{fontSize:22,margin:'5px 0 0'}}>{tab.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+tab.slice(1)} <span style={{color:'#8aa298',fontSize:14}}>({q.data?.length||0})</span></h2></div><AddButton onClick={()=>noWarehousesForLocations?createWarehouseFromLocations():open()}>{noWarehousesForLocations?'Create warehouse first':`Add ${itemName}`}</AddButton></div>{q.isLoading?<div style={{padding:20}}><LoadingRows/></div>:q.isError?<QueryError retry={()=>q.refetch()}/>:!q.data?.length?<Empty title={`No ${tab} yet`} description={emptyDescription}/>:<div className="table-wrap"><table className="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>{tab==='categories'?'Color':tab==='locations'?'Warehouse':'Code'}</th><th>{tab==='categories'?'Products':tab==='locations'?'Kind':'Locations'}</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>{tab==='warehouses'&&wh.data?.map(x=><tr key={x.id}><td><div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:10}}><WarehouseIcon size={17} color="#438078"/><strong>{x.name}</strong></div><small className="subtle">{x.address||'No address'}</small></td><td className="mono">{x.code}</td><td className="mono">{x.locationCount}</td><td><ActionButtons edit={()=>open(x)} remove={()=>setDeleting(x.id)} id={x.id}/></td></tr>)}{tab==='locations'&&loc.data?.map(x=><tr key={x.id}><td><div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:10}}><MapPin size={17} color="#438078"/><strong>{x.name}</strong></div><small className="mono subtle">{x.code}{x.address?` · ${x.address}`:''}</small></td><td>{x.warehouseName}</td><td style={{textTransform:'capitalize'}}>{x.kind}</td><td><ActionButtons edit={()=>open(x)} remove={()=>setDeleting(x.id)} id={x.id}/></td></tr>)}{tab==='categories'&&cat.data?.map(x=><tr key={x.id}><td><div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:10}}><Tags size={17} color="#438078"/><strong>{x.name}</strong></div></td><td><span style={{display:'inline-flex',width:17,height:17,background:x.color,borderRadius:5,verticalAlign:'middle',marginRight:9}}/>{x.color}</td><td className="mono">{x.productCount}</td><td><ActionButtons edit={()=>open(x)} remove={()=>setDeleting(x.id)} id={x.id}/></td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>}</section>{(adding||editing)&&!(tab==='locations'&&!editing&&!wh.isLoading&&!wh.isError&&!wh.data?.length)&&<Modal title={`${editing?'Edit':'Add'} ${itemName}`} onClose={close}><form onSubmit={submit}><div className="grid-fields"><Field label="Name *"><input className="field" required value={name} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)} data-testid="input-setting-name"/></Field>{tab!=='categories'&&<Field label="Code *"><input className="field mono" required value={code} onChange={e=>setCode(e.target.value)} data-testid="input-setting-code"/></Field>}{tab==='warehouses'&&<Field label="Address"><input className="field" value={address} onChange={e=>setAddress(e.target.value)} data-testid="input-warehouse-address"/></Field>}{tab==='locations'&&<><Field label="Warehouse *"><select className="field" required value={warehouse} disabled={!!editing} onChange={e=>setWarehouse(e.target.value)} data-testid="select-location-warehouse"><option value="">Select warehouse</option>{wh.data?.map(w=><option key={w.id} value={w.id}>{w.name}</option>)}</select></Field><Field label="Parent location"><select className="field" value={parent} onChange={e=>setParent(e.target.value)} data-testid="select-location-parent"><option value="">None</option>{loc.data?.filter(l=>l.id!==editing?.id&&(!warehouse||l.warehouseId===Number(warehouse))).map(l=><option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.name}</option>)}</select></Field><Field label="Location kind"><select className="field" value={kind} onChange={e=>setKind(e.target.value as LocationInputKind)} data-testid="select-location-kind">{['internal','supplier','customer','production'].map(k=><option key={k} value={k}>{k}</option>)}</select></Field><Field label="Location address (optional)"><input className="field" value={address} onChange={e=>setAddress(e.target.value)} placeholder="Street, city, and postal code" data-testid="input-location-address"/></Field></>}{tab==='categories'&&<Field label="Color"><div style={{display:'flex',gap:8,alignItems:'center',minHeight:40}}>{colors.map(c=><button key={c} type="button" onClick={()=>setColor(c)} aria-label={`Color ${c}`} data-testid={`button-color-${c.slice(1)}`} style={{width:29,height:29,background:c,borderRadius:8,border:color===c?'3px solid #173b3b':'3px solid transparent',outline:color===c?'2px solid #b5d5c2':'none'}}/>)}</div></Field>}</div>{error&&<p style={{color:'#a34432',fontSize:12}}>{error}</p>}<div style={{display:'flex',justifyContent:'flex-end',gap:9,marginTop:25}}><button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={close}>Cancel</button><button className="btn btn-primary" type="submit" disabled={busy} data-testid="button-save-setting">{busy?'Saving…':'Save changes'}</button></div></form></Modal>}{deleting!==null&&<Confirm title={`Delete ${itemName}?`} description="This action cannot be undone. Records in use by stock, products, or other locations may not be deletable." onClose={()=>setDeleting(null)} onConfirm={remove} busy={dw.isPending||dl.isPending||dc.isPending}/>}</main></Shell>;
}
function ActionButtons({edit,remove,id}:{edit:()=>void;remove:()=>void;id:number}){return <div style={{display:'flex',gap:5,justifyContent:'flex-end'}}><button className="btn btn-outline icon-btn" onClick={edit} aria-label="Edit" data-testid={`button-edit-setting-${id}`}><Pencil size={14}/></button><button className="btn btn-danger icon-btn" onClick={remove} aria-label="Delete" data-testid={`button-delete-setting-${id}`}><Trash2 size={14}/></button></div>}

export type CustomFetchOptions = RequestInit & {
    responseType?: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto";
};
export type ErrorType<T = unknown> = ApiError<T>;
export type BodyType<T> = T;
export type AuthTokenGetter = () => Promise<string | null> | string | null;
/**
 * Set a base URL that is prepended to every relative request URL
 * (i.e. paths that start with `/`).
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles that need to call a remote API server.
 * Pass `null` to clear the base URL.
 */
export declare function setBaseUrl(url: string | null): void;
/**
 * Register a getter that supplies a bearer auth token.  Before every fetch
 * the getter is invoked; when it returns a non-null string, an
 * `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is attached to the request.
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles making token-gated API calls.
 * Pass `null` to clear the getter.
 *
 * NOTE: This function should never be used in web applications where session
 * token cookies are automatically associated with API calls by the browser.
 */
export declare function setAuthTokenGetter(getter: AuthTokenGetter | null): void;
export declare class ApiError<T = unknown> extends Error {
    readonly name = "ApiError";
    readonly status: number;
    readonly statusText: string;
    readonly data: T | null;
    readonly headers: Headers;
    readonly response: Response;
    readonly method: string;
    readonly url: string;
    constructor(response: Response, data: T | null, requestInfo: {
        method: string;
        url: string;
    });
}
export declare class ResponseParseError extends Error {
    readonly name = "ResponseParseError";
    readonly status: number;
    readonly statusText: string;
    readonly headers: Headers;
    readonly response: Response;
    readonly method: string;
    readonly url: string;
    readonly rawBody: string;
    readonly cause: unknown;
    constructor(response: Response, rawBody: string, cause: unknown, requestInfo: {
        method: string;
        url: string;
    });
}
export declare function customFetch<T = unknown>(input: RequestInfo | URL, options?: CustomFetchOptions): Promise<T>;

FILE: lib/api-client-react/src/custom-fetch.ts

export type CustomFetchOptions = RequestInit & {
  responseType?: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto";
};

export type ErrorType<T = unknown> = ApiError<T>;

export type BodyType<T> = T;

export type AuthTokenGetter = () => Promise<string | null> | string | null;

const NO_BODY_STATUS = new Set([204, 205, 304]);
const DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT = "application/json, application/problem+json";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Module-level configuration
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

let _baseUrl: string | null = null;
let _authTokenGetter: AuthTokenGetter | null = null;

/**
 * Set a base URL that is prepended to every relative request URL
 * (i.e. paths that start with `/`).
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles that need to call a remote API server.
 * Pass `null` to clear the base URL.
 */
export function setBaseUrl(url: string | null): void {
  _baseUrl = url ? url.replace(/\/+$/, "") : null;
}

/**
 * Register a getter that supplies a bearer auth token.  Before every fetch
 * the getter is invoked; when it returns a non-null string, an
 * `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is attached to the request.
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles making token-gated API calls.
 * Pass `null` to clear the getter.
 *
 * NOTE: This function should never be used in web applications where session
 * token cookies are automatically associated with API calls by the browser.
 */
export function setAuthTokenGetter(getter: AuthTokenGetter | null): void {
  _authTokenGetter = getter;
}

function isRequest(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is Request {
  return typeof Request !== "undefined" && input instanceof Request;
}

function resolveMethod(input: RequestInfo | URL, explicitMethod?: string): string {
  if (explicitMethod) return explicitMethod.toUpperCase();
  if (isRequest(input)) return input.method.toUpperCase();
  return "GET";
}

// Use loose check for URL — some runtimes (e.g. React Native) polyfill URL
// differently, so `instanceof URL` can fail.
function isUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is URL {
  return typeof URL !== "undefined" && input instanceof URL;
}

function applyBaseUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): RequestInfo | URL {
  if (!_baseUrl) return input;
  const url = resolveUrl(input);
  // Only prepend to relative paths (starting with /)
  if (!url.startsWith("/")) return input;

  const absolute = `${_baseUrl}${url}`;
  if (typeof input === "string") return absolute;
  if (isUrl(input)) return new URL(absolute);
  return new Request(absolute, input as Request);
}

function resolveUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): string {
  if (typeof input === "string") return input;
  if (isUrl(input)) return input.toString();
  return input.url;
}

function mergeHeaders(...sources: Array<HeadersInit | undefined>): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers();

  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!source) continue;
    new Headers(source).forEach((value, key) => {
      headers.set(key, value);
    });
  }

  return headers;
}

function getMediaType(headers: Headers): string | null {
  const value = headers.get("content-type");
  return value ? value.split(";", 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase() : null;
}

function isJsonMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return mediaType === "application/json" || Boolean(mediaType?.endsWith("+json"));
}

function isTextMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return Boolean(
    mediaType &&
      (mediaType.startsWith("text/") ||
        mediaType === "application/xml" ||
        mediaType === "text/xml" ||
        mediaType.endsWith("+xml") ||
        mediaType === "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"),
  );
}

// Use strict equality: in browsers, `response.body` is `null` when the
// response genuinely has no content.  In React Native, `response.body` is
// always `undefined` because the ReadableStream API is not implemented —
// even when the response carries a full payload readable via `.text()` or
// `.json()`.  Loose equality (`== null`) matches both `null` and `undefined`,
// which causes every React Native response to be treated as empty.
function hasNoBody(response: Response, method: string): boolean {
  if (method === "HEAD") return true;
  if (NO_BODY_STATUS.has(response.status)) return true;
  if (response.headers.get("content-length") === "0") return true;
  if (response.body === null) return true;
  return false;
}

function stripBom(text: string): string {
  return text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? text.slice(1) : text;
}

function looksLikeJson(text: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = text.trimStart();
  return trimmed.startsWith("{") || trimmed.startsWith("[");
}

function getStringField(value: unknown, key: string): string | undefined {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return undefined;

  const candidate = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
  if (typeof candidate !== "string") return undefined;

  const trimmed = candidate.trim();
  return trimmed === "" ? undefined : trimmed;
}

function truncate(text: string, maxLength = 300): string {
  return text.length > maxLength ? `${text.slice(0, maxLength - 1)}…` : text;
}

function buildErrorMessage(response: Response, data: unknown): string {
  const prefix = `HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;

  if (typeof data === "string") {
    const text = data.trim();
    return text ? `${prefix}: ${truncate(text)}` : prefix;
  }

  const title = getStringField(data, "title");
  const detail = getStringField(data, "detail");
  const message =
    getStringField(data, "message") ??
    getStringField(data, "error_description") ??
    getStringField(data, "error");

  if (title && detail) return `${prefix}: ${title} — ${detail}`;
  if (detail) return `${prefix}: ${detail}`;
  if (message) return `${prefix}: ${message}`;
  if (title) return `${prefix}: ${title}`;

  return prefix;
}

export class ApiError<T = unknown> extends Error {
  readonly name = "ApiError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly data: T | null;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    data: T | null,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(buildErrorMessage(response, data));
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.data = data;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
  }
}

export class ResponseParseError extends Error {
  readonly name = "ResponseParseError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;
  readonly rawBody: string;
  readonly cause: unknown;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    rawBody: string,
    cause: unknown,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(
      `Failed to parse response from ${requestInfo.method} ${response.url || requestInfo.url} ` +
        `(${response.status} ${response.statusText}) as JSON`,
    );
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
    this.rawBody = rawBody;
    this.cause = cause;
  }
}

async function parseJsonBody(
  response: Response,
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);

  if (normalized.trim() === "") {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(normalized);
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new ResponseParseError(response, raw, cause, requestInfo);
  }
}

async function parseErrorBody(response: Response, method: string): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  // Fall back to text when blob() is unavailable (e.g. some React Native builds).
  if (mediaType && !isJsonMediaType(mediaType) && !isTextMediaType(mediaType)) {
    return typeof response.blob === "function" ? response.blob() : response.text();
  }

  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);
  const trimmed = normalized.trim();

  if (trimmed === "") {
    return null;
  }

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType) || looksLikeJson(normalized)) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(normalized);
    } catch {
      return raw;
    }
  }

  return raw;
}

function inferResponseType(response: Response): "json" | "text" | "blob" {
  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType)) return "json";
  if (isTextMediaType(mediaType) || mediaType == null) return "text";
  return "blob";
}

async function parseSuccessBody(
  response: Response,
  responseType: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto",
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, requestInfo.method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const effectiveType =
    responseType === "auto" ? inferResponseType(response) : responseType;

  switch (effectiveType) {
    case "json":
      return parseJsonBody(response, requestInfo);

    case "text": {
      const text = await response.text();
      return text === "" ? null : text;
    }

    case "blob":
      if (typeof response.blob !== "function") {
        throw new TypeError(
          "Blob responses are not supported in this runtime. " +
            "Use responseType \"json\" or \"text\" instead.",
        );
      }
      return response.blob();
  }
}

export async function customFetch<T = unknown>(
  input: RequestInfo | URL,
  options: CustomFetchOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  input = applyBaseUrl(input);
  const { responseType = "auto", headers: headersInit, ...init } = options;

  const method = resolveMethod(input, init.method);

  if (init.body != null && (method === "GET" || method === "HEAD")) {
    throw new TypeError(`customFetch: ${method} requests cannot have a body.`);
  }

  const headers = mergeHeaders(isRequest(input) ? input.headers : undefined, headersInit);

  if (
    typeof init.body === "string" &&
    !headers.has("content-type") &&
    looksLikeJson(init.body)
  ) {
    headers.set("content-type", "application/json");
  }

  if (responseType === "json" && !headers.has("accept")) {
    headers.set("accept", DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT);
  }

  // Attach bearer token when an auth getter is configured and no
  // Authorization header has been explicitly provided.
  if (_authTokenGetter && !headers.has("authorization")) {
    const token = await _authTokenGetter();
    if (token) {
      headers.set("authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
    }
  }

  const requestInfo = { method, url: resolveUrl(input) };

  const response = await fetch(input, { ...init, method, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorData = await parseErrorBody(response, method);
    throw new ApiError(response, errorData, requestInfo);
  }

  return (await parseSuccessBody(response, responseType, requestInfo)) as T;
}

      type Awaited<O> = O extends AwaitedInput<infer T> ? T : never;

const withQueryKey = <T extends object, K>(query: T, queryKey: K): T & { queryKey: K } => {
  const result = { queryKey } as T & { queryKey: K };
  for (const key of Object.keys(query)) {
    // The explicit queryKey always wins, matching the previous
    // `{ ...query, queryKey }` spread where it was set last.
    if (key === 'queryKey') continue;
    Object.defineProperty(result, key, {
      enumerable: true,
      configurable: true,
      get: () => (query as Record<string, unknown>)[key],
    });
  }
  return result;
};

export const getListLocationsUrl = (params?: ListLocationsParams,) => {
  const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams();

  Object.entries(params || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => {

    if (value !== undefined) {
      normalizedParams.append(key, value === null ? 'null' : String(value))
    }
  });

  const stringifiedParams = normalizedParams.toString();

  return stringifiedParams.length > 0 ? `/api/locations?${stringifiedParams}` : `/api/locations`
}

/**
 * @summary List stock locations
 */
export const listLocations = async (params?: ListLocationsParams, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Location[]> => {

  return customFetch<Location[]>(getListLocationsUrl(params),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'GET'


  }
);}

    return [
    `/api/locations`, ...(params ? [params] : [])
    ] as const;
    }

) => {

const {query: queryOptions, request: requestOptions} = options ?? {};

   return  { queryKey, queryFn, ...queryOptions} as UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listLocations>>, TError, TData> & { queryKey: QueryKey }
}

export type ListLocationsQueryResult = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listLocations>>>
export type ListLocationsQueryError = ErrorType<unknown>

 params?: ListLocationsParams, options?: { query?:UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listLocations>>, TError, TData>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}

 ):  UseQueryResult<TData, TError> & { queryKey: QueryKey } {

  const queryOptions = getListLocationsQueryOptions(params,options)

  const query = useQuery(queryOptions) as  UseQueryResult<TData, TError> & { queryKey: QueryKey };

  return withQueryKey(query, queryOptions.queryKey);

export const getCreateLocationUrl = () => {




  return `/api/locations`
}

/**
 * @summary Create a stock location
 */
export const createLocation = async (locationInput: LocationInput, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Location> => {

    const getHeaders = (h?: NonNullable<RequestInit['headers']>): Record<string, string | readonly string[]> => {
    if (!h) return {};
    if (h instanceof Headers) return Object.fromEntries(h.entries());
    if (Symbol.iterator in h) {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        Array.from(h as Iterable<Iterable<string>>, (entry) => Array.from(entry) as [string, string]),
      );
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string | readonly string[]> = {};
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries<string | readonly string[] | undefined>(h)) {
      if (value !== undefined) headers[name] = value;
    }
    return headers;
  };
return customFetch<Location>(getCreateLocationUrl(),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...getHeaders(options?.headers) },
    body: JSON.stringify(locationInput)
  }
);}

export const getUpdateOperationUrl = (id: number,) => {




  return `/api/operations/${id}`
}

/**
 * @summary Edit a draft operation
 */
export const updateOperation = async (id: number,
    operationUpdate: OperationUpdate, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Operation> => {

    const getHeaders = (h?: NonNullable<RequestInit['headers']>): Record<string, string | readonly string[]> => {
    if (!h) return {};
    if (h instanceof Headers) return Object.fromEntries(h.entries());
    if (Symbol.iterator in h) {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        Array.from(h as Iterable<Iterable<string>>, (entry) => Array.from(entry) as [string, string]),
      );
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string | readonly string[]> = {};
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries<string | readonly string[] | undefined>(h)) {
      if (value !== undefined) headers[name] = value;
    }
    return headers;
  };
return customFetch<Operation>(getUpdateOperationUrl(id),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...getHeaders(options?.headers) },
    body: JSON.stringify(operationUpdate)
  }
);}

export const getListMovesUrl = (params?: ListMovesParams,) => {
  const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams();

  Object.entries(params || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => {

    if (value !== undefined) {
      normalizedParams.append(key, value === null ? 'null' : String(value))
    }
  });

  const stringifiedParams = normalizedParams.toString();

  return stringifiedParams.length > 0 ? `/api/moves?${stringifiedParams}` : `/api/moves`
}

/**
 * @summary Browse the stock movement ledger
 */
export const listMoves = async (params?: ListMovesParams, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<StockMove[]> => {

  return customFetch<StockMove[]>(getListMovesUrl(params),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'GET'


  }
);}
